title: Celebration and Sorrow: Americans React to the Election

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报《DealBook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Across the country this weekend, there was both celebration and sorrow as Americans absorbed the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 这个周末，随着美国人接受选举结果，全国各地既有庆祝也有悲伤。

sentences.en: Today, we hear from supporters of the president and the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们倾听总统和当选总统支持者的心声。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月9日星期一。

sentences.en: This is Robert Jimmison in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 我是来自佐治亚州的罗伯特·吉米森。

sentences.en: Tonight, we're seeing all over this nation, all cities and all parts of the country,
sentences.zh: 今晚，我们看到在这个国家的各个地方、所有城市和全国各地，

sentences.en: indeed, across the world, an outpouring of joy, of hope, renewed faith, and tomorrow bring a better day.
sentences.zh: 甚至全世界，都洋溢着喜悦、希望、重生的信念，明天将迎来美好的一天。

sentences.en: On Saturday night, I went out in Atlanta, where hundreds of people were gathered in the streets, looking at their cell phones and nearby TV screens set up at sidewalk bars.
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，我去了亚特兰大，那里有数百人聚集在街头，看着他们的手机和路边酒吧附近架设的电视屏幕。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: As Joe Biden and Kamala Harris delivered their victory speeches as the president and vice president-elect.
sentences.zh: 当乔·拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯以当选总统和副总统身份发表胜利演讲时。

sentences.en: And what a testament it is to Joe's character that he had the audacity to break one of the most substantial barriers that exists in our country
sentences.zh: 乔有勇气打破我国存在的最重大的壁垒之一，这证明了他的品格，

sentences.en: and select a woman as his vice president.
sentences.zh: 并选择了一位女性担任他的副总统。

sentences.en: But while I may be the first woman in this office, I will not be the laSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然我可能是这个职位上的第一位女性，但我绝不会是最后一位。

sentences.en: And while it was Pennsylvania that delivered the Democrats the electoral college votes they needed
sentences.zh: 尽管正是宾夕法尼亚州为民主党人赢得了他们冲过终点线所需的选举人票，

sentences.en: to get across the finish line, the polls in Georgia were showing that it's looking increasingly likely that the state will flip blue for the first time since 1992.
sentences.zh: 但佐治亚州的民调显示，该州自1992年以来首次变蓝的可能性越来越大。

sentences.en: If that happens, it will be because of the increasing diversity of the state,
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，那将是因为该州日益多元化，

sentences.en: Atlanta in particular, and a massive get-out-the-vote effort in recent years.
sentences.zh: 尤其是亚特兰大，以及近年来大规模的动员投票努力。

sentences.en: So I spent the night walking around talking to people about how they were feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以我花了一晚上的时间四处走动，跟人们聊聊他们的感受。

sentences.en: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris just finished speaking.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯刚刚演讲结束。

sentences.en: What are you guys feeling right now?
sentences.zh: 你们现在有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Excitement.
sentences.zh: 兴奋。

sentences.en: I got emotional about it.
sentences.zh: 我为此感动得情绪激动。

sentences.en: For me, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Not only the first woman, but it's a black woman and a woman of color.
sentences.zh: 不仅是第一位女性，而且是一位黑人女性，一位有色人种女性。

sentences.en: You can't really explain how it feels to be a black woman.
sentences.zh: 你真的无法形容身为黑人女性是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I feel like you can finally see yourself in politics.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你终于能在政坛看到自己的影子了。

sentences.en: Like, you see so many young women in Kamala.
sentences.zh: 就像，你在卡玛拉身上看到了那么多年轻女性的身影。

sentences.en: Just being a black woman and seeing Kamala be the first black vice president, female, it just feels really good.
sentences.zh: 仅仅作为一个黑人女性，看到卡玛拉成为第一位黑人副总统、女性副总统，这种感觉真的太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm sure so many little black girls out there are so emotional about it.
sentences.zh: 我确信外面的很多小黑女孩都为此激动不已。

sentences.en: Any little girl, black or of color, period.
sentences.zh: 任何小女孩，黑人或有色人种，绝对如此。

sentences.en: Period.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: They can, yes.
sentences.zh: 她们可以，是的。

sentences.en: Like, to see in that kind of role.
sentences.zh: 就像，看到有人担任那种角色。

sentences.en: I have little cousins, little black girls, and they can look up to her and realize that they can be vice president.
sentences.zh: 我有小表妹们，都是小黑女孩，她们可以仰望她，并意识到她们也能成为副总统。

sentences.en: They can be president.
sentences.zh: 她们可以成为总统。

sentences.en: They can be whatever they want to be.
sentences.zh: 她们可以成为她们想成为的任何人物。

sentences.en: I took my little niece to the polls with me, and she was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我带着我的小侄女去投票站，她非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But to actually see it come to life, and she's like, auntie, I helped you vote.
sentences.zh: 但看到它真正变成现实，她说，姑姑，我帮了你投票。

sentences.en: I helped make that happen.
sentences.zh: 我促成了这件事。

sentences.en: So today when we won, she was like, I can't believe it, auntie.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们赢了的时候，她说，我简直不敢相信，姑姑。

sentences.en: And I said, baby, you can do anything you want to do.
sentences.zh: 我对她说，宝贝，你想做什么就能做什么。

sentences.en: And that's exactly how I feel tonight.
sentences.zh: 这正是我今晚的感受。

sentences.en: I just got overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 我只是感到不知所措。

sentences.en: I just, the tears just started flowing, and I just feel like it happened in my lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我只是，眼泪夺眶而出，我只是觉得这发生在了我有生之年。

sentences.en: Um, I told my niece before I got here, baby, because she is, you can.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我来这儿之前跟我侄女说过，宝贝，因为她是，你可以的。

sentences.en: And I told her to repeat that to me, and I think, and I just want her to know that she can, because she did.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她把那句话重复给我听，我想，我只想让她知道她可以，因为她做到了。

sentences.en: I think that's the most important part for me, the next generation.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说最重要的是下一代。

sentences.en: That's what it means to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说意义重大。

sentences.en: My niece can see that in her lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我的侄女能在她有生之年看到这一点。

sentences.en: It definitely makes a difference for younger people, but I talk to people like my mom that's
sentences.zh: 这绝对给年轻人带来了改变，但我跟像我妈妈这样的人谈过，她们

sentences.en: in their 60s, and they're just as emotional about it, because it's something they didn't think they would see.
sentences.zh: 已经60多岁了，她们同样情绪激动，因为这是她们以前认为看不到的事情。

sentences.en: Did you call your mom today?
sentences.zh: 你今天给你妈妈打电话了吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely, yeah.
sentences.zh: 当然打了，是的。

sentences.en: What was that phone call like?
sentences.zh: 那通电话感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I called my mom and my stepmom, which are both around the same age, and they're just so ecstatic.
sentences.zh: 我给妈妈和继母打了电话，她们年纪差不多，都兴奋极了。

sentences.en: And my stepmom specifically said, I'm so relieved for my people.
sentences.zh: 我的继母特别说道，我为我的人民感到由衷的释怀。

sentences.en: Honestly, it just means that the possibilities, like President-elect Biden said, they're endless.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这意味着正如当选总统拜登所说，可能性是无限的。

sentences.en: So now that we have an African-American woman as the vice president, the door is open.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们有了一位非裔美国女性担任副总统，这扇门已经打开了。

sentences.en: We're just going to walk in.
sentences.zh: 我们将直接走进去。

sentences.en: I heard Vice President-elect Harris talk about, she had a very inclusive message.
sentences.zh: 我听到当选副总统哈里斯谈到，她传达了一个极具包容性的信息。

sentences.en: What does that mean to be standing in such a diverse community and hear that message come from someone about to take an office in the White House?
sentences.zh: 身处这样一个多元化的社区，听到即将入主白宫的人传递这样一条信息，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I just feel like everybody, the weight is lifted.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得每个人，重担都卸下了。

sentences.en: I feel like everybody feels like, just hope.
sentences.zh: 我觉得每个人都感受到，只有希望。

sentences.en: We're a gay couple, and so it just, how do you feel?
sentences.zh: 我们是一对同性伴侣，所以它只是——你感觉如何？

sentences.en: This means I get to marry her and not fear that we couldn't get married in our state.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我可以嫁给她，而不必担心我们无法在自己的州结婚。

sentences.en: This means we can have kids.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们可以生孩子。

sentences.en: I don't have to fear for my dad's life as much as I used to.
sentences.zh: 我不再像过去那样那么担心我父亲的生命安全了。

sentences.en: Why did you fear for your dad's life?
sentences.zh: 你为什么担心你父亲的生命安全？

sentences.en: I mean, being a black man, I mean, you're always worried.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一个黑人男性，我是说，你总是提心吊胆。

sentences.en: Every time he leaves the house, you're always worried.
sentences.zh: 每次他离开家，你总是忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying that's completely gone, but it just gives me a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 我不是说这种担心完全消失了，但它确实让我松了一口气。

sentences.en: Like, you can just breathe a little bit.
sentences.zh: 就像，你终于可以稍微喘口气了。

sentences.en: But this just means we get to finally be in a world where we can see some change.
sentences.zh: 但这只是意味着我们终于可以身处一个能看到一些改变的世界。

sentences.en: We were really worried about things being reversed, a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很担心事情会被逆转，很多事情。

sentences.en: So, it just changed.
sentences.zh: 所以，它改变了。

sentences.en: It changed a lot.
sentences.zh: 它改变了很多。

sentences.en: For me, it was less happy and more relief.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，与其说是高兴，不如说是释怀。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What do you guys both make of Georgia turning blue this year?
sentences.zh: 你们两个怎么看佐治亚州今年变蓝这件事？

sentences.en: I think it's fucking awesome.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这他妈太棒了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Just in general, to say that we live in Georgia that has turned from red to blue, we turn blue, baby.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，能说我们生活在佐治亚州，这里从红变蓝，我们变蓝了，宝贝。

sentences.en: So, that's the only thing that matters.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是唯一要紧的事。

sentences.en: We turn blue.
sentences.zh: 我们变蓝了。

sentences.en: So, I feel like it's a miracle.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉这简直是个奇迹。

sentences.en: It feels like a true miracle in Georgia that we are blue.
sentences.zh: 我们在佐治亚州变成蓝色，感觉就像一个真正的奇迹。

sentences.en: I just can't even believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: But, as the numbers kept coming in and it got more and more of a lead, what did that feel like?
sentences.zh: 但是，随着数字不断涌现，领先优势越来越大，那种感觉是怎样的？

sentences.en: We felt super anxious.
sentences.zh: 我们感到超级焦虑。

sentences.en: I mean, I kept thinking, could this reverse?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一直在想，这会逆转吗？

sentences.en: Like, could it go back?
sentences.zh: 就像，它会变回去吗？

sentences.en: So, I actually watched it closer because of that.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我其实盯得更紧了。

sentences.en: Like, we've had the TV on since Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们从周二开始就一直开着电视。

sentences.en: Listen, I really, we have to give a big shout out to Stacey Ables because I really feel like she is a big part of what changed in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 听着，我真的——我们必须对斯泰西·艾布拉姆斯表示大大的感谢，因为我真的觉得她是佐治亚州发生改变的重要推手。

sentences.en: Getting out there, she may have lost to the governor, but she was like, never again.
sentences.zh: 她走了出去，虽然她可能输给了州长，但她态度坚决，绝不再发生这种事。

sentences.en: And she came out, she made sure that people were voting, people who felt like they didn't get a chance.
sentences.zh: 她站了出来，确保人们去投票，那些觉得自己没有机会的人。

sentences.en: She just was hitting those streets.
sentences.zh: 她一直在街头奔走。

sentences.en: And I really feel like that played a big part in Georgia flipping.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得这在佐治亚州翻盘中起到了重要作用。

sentences.en: I'm so happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到太高兴了。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I don't think it would have been this way if every vote had not been counted at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果归根结底没有统计每一张选票，情况就不会是这样。

sentences.en: We would still be red.
sentences.zh: 我们依然会是红色。

sentences.en: You know, there's something fishy going on here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里面肯定有猫腻。

sentences.en: And I think the other side has resorted to shenanigans to sway the bull.
sentences.zh: 我认为另一方已经诉诸诡计来左右选举。

sentences.en: This is Elise Spiegel in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 这是来自费城的埃利斯·斯皮格尔。

sentences.en: On Friday night, before the election was called for Biden, I went downtown to the Philadelphia Convention Center where poll workers were counting,
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，在拜登胜选被宣布之前，我去了市中心的费城会议中心，那里的计票员正在清点选票，

sentences.en: trying to figure out which candidate had won the state.
sentences.zh: 试图弄清楚哪个候选人赢得了该州。

sentences.en: All day long, there had been these unsubstantiated rumors on social media claiming that the people inside were altering and destroying Trump ballots
sentences.zh: 一整天，社交媒体上都在流传着这些未经证实谣言，称里面的人在篡改和销毁特朗普的选票，

sentences.en: and not letting observers stand at a reasonable distance.
sentences.zh: 并且不让观察员站在合理的距离观看。

sentences.en: So some protesters had shown up, including this small woman with long hair named Lauren.
sentences.zh: 所以一些抗议者出现了，包括这个名叫劳伦留着长发的小个子女人。

sentences.en: She was a Trump supporter who drove all the way from her home in New Jersey because she said she had to do something.
sentences.zh: 她是一位特朗普支持者，一路从她位于新泽西州的家中驱车赶来，因为她说她必须做点什么。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: And if there's something criminal going on, especially here where the Declaration of Independence was signed,
sentences.zh: 如果有任何犯罪行为正在发生，特别是在这里，在《独立宣言》签署的地方，

sentences.en: we all deserve to know.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都理应知道真相。

sentences.en: We all deserve to know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我们都理应知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Lauren had traveled so far because the idea that the poll workers inside were stealing the election was horrifying to her.
sentences.zh: 劳伦大老远赶来，是因为里面的人在窃取选举成果这种想法让她感到惊恐。

sentences.en: But maybe just as bad in her mind was the fact that outside there were hundreds of people celebrating that injustice.
sentences.zh: 但在她看来，同样糟糕的是，外面有数百人正在为这种不公而庆祝。

sentences.en: Some local Democratic groups had decided to put on a dance party after Biden pulled ahead.
sentences.zh: 一些当地的民主党团体决定在拜登领先之后举办一场舞会。

sentences.en: So all around us, there were people swaying and laughing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们四周到处都是摇摆和欢笑的人群。

sentences.en: And to Lauren, it felt like they were literally dancing in the streets as her rights were being taken from her.
sentences.zh: 对劳伦来说，这感觉就像当她的权利被剥夺时，人们竟然在街头载歌载舞。

sentences.en: The fact that people are seeming to be not concerned at all with the possibility that malfeasance has occurred is what makes me sad.
sentences.zh: 人们似乎对发生舞弊的可能性毫不关心，正是这一点让我感到难过。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm just seeing a real lack of critical thinking in so many people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我看到很多人确实缺乏批判性思维。

sentences.en: I just want fairness.
sentences.zh: 我只想要公平。

sentences.en: And I want to know that my vote counted.
sentences.zh: 我希望知道我的选票算数了。

sentences.en: Lauren said that since COVID, her life had really nosedived.
sentences.zh: 劳伦说，自从新冠疫情以来，她的生活真的急转直下。

sentences.en: She'd lost her small business when the Democratic governor of New Jersey ordered a COVID lockdown.
sentences.zh: 当新泽西州民主党州长下令实施新冠封锁时，她的小生意破产了。

sentences.en: And her kids were also having a hard time.
sentences.zh: 她的孩子们也过得很艰难。

sentences.en: You know, my kids, what is there for them now?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的孩子们，他们现在还有什么？

sentences.en: You know, my daughter was very socially active in her school and very involved in extracurricular activities that she literally has no zest or desire to do anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我女儿在学校里非常活跃，积极参与课外活动，但她现在简直没有任何精力和愿望去做了。

sentences.en: These kids are sitting in their houses, in their bedrooms, doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子坐在他们的房子里，在卧室里，什么也不做。

sentences.en: I mean, she tells my husband that she doesn't even want to go to college.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她告诉我丈夫她甚至不想上大学。
